verdict.rationale: Bolna's docs describe a quickstart that goes from an API key to a real phone call, with transcript and recording, in about five minutes. Agent Studio claims a call-ready agent in 5–8 minutes, voices and accents are selectable, prompts are configurable per language, and phone numbers can be managed through built-in Twilio/Plivo telephony or the CLI, so the one-hour target is credibly met on vendor claims. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the time-to-first-call, and detailed documentation of buying or assigning a phone number for a live call.
